exposure: COVID-19 during first or second trimester pregnancy
cohort: 90 pregnant women aged 18-35 years with COVID-19 in their first or second trimester.
finding: COVID-19 in the first and second trimester was associated with high rates of psychological distress but relatively low rates of adverse birth outcomes, including low perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The number of C-sections among the cases was 47 (52.2%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was found in 22 (24.4%) cases.
